details: Malicious package. `setup.py` runs base64-encoded code with `exec` on every invocation except `sdist`, i.e. during `pip install`. On Windows it writes an embedded 429 KB executable to the temp directory (`P3c8b0f54872f923c2cd896f7b5.exe`) and starts it. On Linux it looks up the public IP and ISP via ip-api.com (and exits if the ISP is Google or Mythic Beasts), takes a screenshot, collects Firefox and Thunderbird credential and cookie stores (key4.db, logins.json, cookies.sqlite), FileZilla saved servers, Pidgin accounts, Telegram Desktop tdata sessions and Electrum and Exodus wallets, zips and RC4-encrypts them, and uploads the archive to a Telegram bot (bot 6209822134, chat -1001529292045). Observed in a sandboxed install (ip-api.com and api.telegram.org connections). It belongs to the WhiteSnake infostealer campaign on PyPI (April 2023); sibling packages such as libidrequest (MAL-2024-5318) and libideeee (MAL-2024-5315) are already recorded. The package has been removed from PyPI.
